session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend from the Open, Trading Range' (axis 09:00-15:00). The first two bars signaled a selloff leading to sideways trading with scale-in bulls trapped, the climactic bear trend down through the minor wedge (larger 2nd leg down likely) into 3840, the DT wedge bear flag at 3860, a lower-high double top at 3838 over the midday chop, the HL MTR higher-low reversal at 3822 and the magenta wedge rally into the close.
